test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 1 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Zeal
solution:
Here the correct answer is** Apathy.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"zeal"** refers to **a strong enthusiasm or passion for something.**
 
• The most appropriate antonym of "**zeal**" is option 4, "**apathy**," which means** a lack of interest, enthusiasm, or emotion.**</li
